This anonymous adapter is allowlisted to the VizieR copy of catalogue I/355/gaiadr3, stores catalog rows and provider links only, and does not query unrelated VizieR collections or retrieve DataLink products.
Each retained row passed a mission-specific past-release check; XMM also required data_in_heasarc=Y and NICER required VALIDATED. No file bytes were downloaded.

The anonymous public NED TAP service documents programmatic cone searches of the NED Object Directory and requests NED acknowledgment. CTAS retains bounded source-native rows and provenance only. Rubin alert packets are world-public with no proprietary period, and Fink documents its LSST Science Portal and REST API as real-time, public services requiring no login. Coordinate and first-detection proximity are not proof of source identity.

This adapter uses the anonymous official TAP service for one bounded coordinate query, retains provider attribution and source bibcodes, and does not treat a nearby literature object as the transient, its host, or a new detection.
